newsitem.title: ITALY: SOCCER-ITALIAN PLAYER TESTS POSITIVE FOR CAFFEINE.
newsitem.headline: SOCCER-ITALIAN PLAYER TESTS POSITIVE FOR CAFFEINE.

text.p: Italian soccer player Cristiano Gagliarducci of serie C club Frosinone has tested positive for caffeine, officials said on Wednesday.
The Italian soccer federation said the first test was carried out after a home match against Catania on November 17 and a second sample had confirmed the result.
The federation said in a statement that it had passed its findings on to a disciplinary body for further action.
Caffeine is a stimulant and athletes face bans when levels in urine samples exceed permitted levels.
It has sparked controversy, however, because its is found naturally in coffee, tea and carbonated cola drinks.
